_readme: Find-miss shapes from the demand board, in neutral rewordings (never the recorded text), each with the slug (or any of the slugs) that must rank first; every row must also read as served. Add a row whenever a find-miss names a capability we sell. Run by scripts/test-find-misses-corpus.js. `gaps` are real capability gaps phrased the same way: a nearby tool may rank first, but none of them does the operation, so each must stay a miss (the need is recorded). An optional `lead` is the least ratio of the first row's score to the second's: a tool that must win clearly, not by a hair.
